Proposed rotation (high level):

- Week B (EMEA-friendly): 10:00 PT / 19:00 CET / 12:00 SGT
- Week C (APAC-friendly): 12:00 PT / 21:00 CET / 15:00 SGT

1) lock the first two rotation slots and send calendar invites (we'll create timezone-aware invites),
2) share a short rotation-plan.xlsx (roles + recording/re-run cadence), and
3) run a sandbox in the week following the first session.

Attachments: post-call-recap.pdf, availability-grid.csv

Thanks — I can be flexible next Thursday/Friday for scheduling.
